title: My Projects
text:
PORTFOLIO

Show all Georgetown UVA Applications Publications





GitHub View Project


VibeCheck
Georgetown University • DSAN 6700: Machine Learning App Deployment
An application that allows users to discover restaurants in Washington, DC by their vibe, rather than food type! Just enter a text description (“cozy”, “romantic”, etc) or a reference photo, and VibeCheck will return similar vibes by extracting multimodal embeddings from images & text (CLIP + SentenceBERT) and returning fast similarity search using vector indexing.





GitHub View Project


HairNet
Georgetown University • DSAN 6600: Neural Networks and Deep Learning
HairNet, a final project for DSAN 6600, introduces the first deep learning model for full Andre Walker 10-class hair typing, achieving 53.7% top-1 and 88.7% within-one-class accuracy using EfficientNetV2-M with ordinal regression on a custom ~14k-image dataset.





IEEE FEDS Notes


LLM on a Budget: Active Knowledge Distillation for Efficient Classification of Large Text Corpora
Federal Reserve Board
This research proposes M-RARU, an active learning method that intelligently selects which data points a large language model should label when training smaller “student” models, rather than having the LLM label everything. This approach reduces the number of samples needed by up to 80% compared to random sampling, cutting costs and training time while maintaining classification accuracy.
